title: Term
description: A clause within an Instrument. Bound to gist:ContractTerm. A Term creates Obligations and may defeat other Terms.

section.description: Section / article / paragraph identifier within the parent Instrument.

parent_instrument.description: IRI of the of:Instrument this Term belongs to.

creates.description: IRIs of of:Obligation records created by this Term.

defeats.description: IRIs of of:Term records this Term overrides per defeasibility semantics.

anchors.description: IRIs of of:Term records this Term interprets or references. Used by JIAs and other interpretive Instruments whose Terms ground out in a statutory Term. Cross-portfolio joins (PubLedge JIA Term → EveryAILaw statutory Term) use this predicate.

executableEncoding.description: Optional pointer to an executable encoding of this Term's logic.
